description: Spot plus forwards and swaps for a precious metals and FX desk

list.label: symbol
list.name: SYMBOL

title: FX and Metals: Spot and Forwards

panels.description: Visualizes the order book snapshot for the selected currency pair, showing the price and cumulative volume at each bid and ask level. The area under the green (bids) and red (asks) lines represents market liquidity on both sides, with the mid-price and top volume “walls” highlighted for quick identification of major support and resistance.

targets.rawSql:
WITH snapshot AS (
  SELECT timestamp, bids, asks
  FROM market_data
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) and  symbol = '${SYMBOL}'
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT timestamp, bids[1] as bprices, bids[2] as bvolumes, array_cum_sum(bids[2]) as bcumvolumes,asks[1] as aprices, asks[2] as avolumes, array_cum_sum(asks[2]) as acumvolumes from snapshot;

panels.title: Market Depth - ${SYMBOL}

panels.description: Compares the best bid in the order book (from L2 market data) using an ASOF JOIN against the corresponding “core” quote price from upstream sources (e.g., ECNs). This table helps detect price alignment issues, latency, or anomalies between your live order book and reference prices provided by liquidity venues.
panels.title: Top-of-book Price vs Core Price - ${SYMBOL}

panels.description: Candlestick chart summarizing price action using the best bid from the order book, aggregated into 1-minute intervals. Each candlestick shows the open, high, low, and close bid price, along with traded volume. Ideal for visualizing price trends, volatility, and market regime changes over time. Data is queried from a materialized view.

targets.rawSql:
select timestamp, first(bids[1,1]) open, max(bids[1,1]) high, 
min(bids[1,1]) low,  last(bids[1,1]) close, sum(bids[2,1]) total_volume 
        from market_data
        where  $__timeFilter(timestamp) and symbol = '${SYMBOL}'
        sample by 1s

panels.title: OHLC - Bids - 1m - (${SYMBOL})

panels.description: Latest forward ladder for the pair: value date, bid and ask points (pips), outrights against the latest core_price spot, and the base-currency rate implied by the points and the quote-currency curve (for a metal, the implied lease rate). ON and TN settle before spot: their outrights are spot minus the cumulative points.
panels.title: Forward Curve (points in pips) - ${SYMBOL}

targets.rawSql:
DECLARE
  @pip := CASE WHEN '${SYMBOL}' LIKE '%JPY' THEN 0.01 WHEN '${SYMBOL}' = 'XAGUSD' THEN 0.001 WHEN '${SYMBOL}' LIKE 'X%' THEN 0.01 ELSE 0.0001 END,
  @dp := CASE WHEN '${SYMBOL}' LIKE '%JPY' OR '${SYMBOL}' LIKE 'X%' THEN 4 WHEN '${SYMBOL}' = 'XAGUSD' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END,
  @quote := right('${SYMBOL}', 3),
  @base_basis := CASE WHEN left('${SYMBOL}', 3) = 'GBP' THEN 365.0 ELSE 360.0 END
WITH
  quote_curve AS (
    SELECT tenor, CASE @quote WHEN 'USD' THEN usd WHEN 'EUR' THEN eur WHEN 'JPY' THEN jpy
                              WHEN 'CHF' THEN chf WHEN 'CAD' THEN cad END AS quote_rate
    FROM (
                SELECT 'ON' tenor, 3.88 usd, 2.42 eur, 1.23 jpy, -0.05 chf, 2.24 cad FROM long_sequence(1)
      UNION ALL SELECT 'TN', 3.88, 2.42, 1.23, -0.05, 2.24 FROM long_sequence(1)
      UNION ALL SELECT '1W', 3.88, 2.43, 1.23, -0.04, 2.24 FROM long_sequence(1)
      UNION ALL SELECT '2W', 3.89, 2.44, 1.24, -0.04, 2.23 FROM long_sequence(1)
      UNION ALL SELECT '1M', 3.90, 2.46, 1.25, -0.03, 2.22 FROM long_sequence(1)
      UNION ALL SELECT '2M', 3.92, 2.49, 1.26, -0.02, 2.21 FROM long_sequence(1)
      UNION ALL SELECT '3M', 3.93, 2.52, 1.27, -0.01, 2.20 FROM long_sequence(1)
      UNION ALL SELECT '6M', 3.95, 2.58, 1.30, 0.01, 2.18 FROM long_sequence(1)
      UNION ALL SELECT '9M', 3.95, 2.62, 1.33, 0.03, 2.16 FROM long_sequence(1)
      UNION ALL SELECT '1Y', 3.94, 2.65, 1.35, 0.05, 2.15 FROM long_sequence(1)
    )
  ),
  spot AS (
    SELECT bid_price, ask_price FROM core_price
    WHERE symbol = '${SYMBOL}' AND timestamp <= $__toTime
    LATEST ON timestamp PARTITION BY symbol
  ),
  curve AS (
    SELECT tenor, tenor_days, value_date, bid_points, ask_points, spot_ref FROM fx_forward_points
    WHERE symbol = '${SYMBOL}' AND timestamp <= $__toTime
    LATEST ON timestamp PARTITION BY tenor
  ),
  ladder AS (
    SELECT tenor, tenor_days, value_date, bid_points, ask_points, spot_ref,
      sum(CASE WHEN tenor_days < 0 THEN bid_points END)
        OVER (ORDER BY tenor_days DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_bid,
      sum(CASE WHEN tenor_days < 0 THEN ask_points END)
        OVER (ORDER BY tenor_days DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_ask,
      CASE WHEN tenor_days < 0
           THEN least(lead(tenor_days) OVER (ORDER BY tenor_days), 0) - tenor_days
           ELSE tenor_days END AS days
    FROM curve
  )
SELECT l.tenor AS Tenor, l.value_date AS "Value date", l.bid_points AS "Bid", l.ask_points AS "Ask",
  round(CASE WHEN l.tenor_days < 0 THEN s.bid_price - l.cum_ask * @pip ELSE s.bid_price + l.bid_points * @pip END, @dp) AS "Out bid",
  round(CASE WHEN l.tenor_days < 0 THEN s.ask_price - l.cum_bid * @pip ELSE s.ask_price + l.ask_points * @pip END, @dp) AS "Out ask",
  round(((1 + q.quote_rate / 100 * l.days / 360)
          / (1 + (l.bid_points + l.ask_points) / 2 * @pip / l.spot_ref) - 1) * @base_basis / l.days * 100, 3) AS "Impl %"
FROM ladder l
JOIN quote_curve q ON q.tenor = l.tenor
CROSS JOIN spot s
ORDER BY l.tenor_days

panels.description: Every 3M ladder over the last 15 minutes (one every 5 s): the mid forward points (right axis) and the spot mid each ladder was priced on (spot_ref).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT timestamp, spot_ref AS spot, (bid_points + ask_points) / 2 AS "3M points"
FROM fx_forward_points
WHERE symbol = '${SYMBOL}' AND tenor = '3M' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)

panels.title: 3M Points vs Spot - ${SYMBOL}
Triangular Consistency Gap (pips)
panels.description: Absolute gap, per tenor, between the published EURJPY and XAUEUR points and the points implied by their legs (EURUSD x USDJPY, XAUUSD / EURUSD), at the latest complete minute of the selected time range. A bar over the 1-pip line is a bad point in one feed. The generator plants one daily from 09:20 to 09:40 UTC: set the time range to end inside it to see it.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
  prem AS (
    SELECT timestamp, tenor,
      max(CASE WHEN symbol = 'EURUSD' THEN (bid_points + ask_points) / 2 * 0.0001 / spot_ref END) AS eurusd,
      max(CASE WHEN symbol = 'USDJPY' THEN (bid_points + ask_points) / 2 * 0.01 / spot_ref END) AS usdjpy,
      max(CASE WHEN symbol = 'XAUUSD' THEN (bid_points + ask_points) / 2 * 0.01 / spot_ref END) AS xauusd,
      max(CASE WHEN symbol = 'EURJPY' THEN (bid_points + ask_points) / 2 END) AS eurjpy_points,
      max(CASE WHEN symbol = 'EURJPY' THEN spot_ref END) AS eurjpy_spot,
      max(CASE WHEN symbol = 'XAUEUR' THEN (bid_points + ask_points) / 2 END) AS xaueur_points,
      max(CASE WHEN symbol = 'XAUEUR' THEN spot_ref END) AS xaueur_spot,
      max(tenor_days) AS tenor_days
    FROM fx_forward_points_1m
    WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND symbol IN ('EURUSD', 'USDJPY', 'EURJPY', 'XAUUSD', 'XAUEUR')
    GROUP BY timestamp, tenor
  ),
  -- Only finished minutes: within a 5-second cycle EURUSD publishes before the gold pairs, so
  -- in the minute still being written a cross and its legs can be a rate step apart.
  complete AS (
    SELECT * FROM prem
    WHERE eurusd IS NOT NULL AND usdjpy IS NOT NULL AND eurjpy_points IS NOT NULL
      AND timestamp < timestamp_floor('m', now())
  ),
  latest AS (SELECT max(timestamp) AS ts FROM complete)
SELECT c.tenor AS Tenor,
  round(abs(c.eurjpy_points - c.eurjpy_spot * ((1 + c.eurusd) * (1 + c.usdjpy) - 1) / 0.01), 2) AS EURJPY,
  round(abs(c.xaueur_points - c.xaueur_spot * ((1 + c.xauusd) / (1 + c.eurusd) - 1) / 0.01), 2) AS XAUEUR
FROM complete c CROSS JOIN latest l
WHERE c.timestamp = l.ts
ORDER BY c.tenor_days

panels.description: Spot against each forward tenor: bid swap = far bid - near ask, ask swap = far ask - near bid (the near leg is spot, so they are the tenor's points), the implied swap rate (the annualised forward premium of the period), and the far-leg outrights against the latest core_price spot.
panels.title: Swap Ladder from Spot - ${SYMBOL}

targets.rawSql:
DECLARE
  @pip := CASE WHEN '${SYMBOL}' LIKE '%JPY' THEN 0.01 WHEN '${SYMBOL}' = 'XAGUSD' THEN 0.001 WHEN '${SYMBOL}' LIKE 'X%' THEN 0.01 ELSE 0.0001 END,
  @dp := CASE WHEN '${SYMBOL}' LIKE '%JPY' OR '${SYMBOL}' LIKE 'X%' THEN 4 WHEN '${SYMBOL}' = 'XAGUSD' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END
WITH
  spot AS (
    SELECT bid_price, ask_price FROM core_price
    WHERE symbol = '${SYMBOL}' AND timestamp <= $__toTime
    LATEST ON timestamp PARTITION BY symbol
  ),
  curve AS (
    SELECT tenor, tenor_days, bid_points, ask_points, spot_ref FROM fx_forward_points
    WHERE symbol = '${SYMBOL}' AND timestamp <= $__toTime
    LATEST ON timestamp PARTITION BY tenor
  )
SELECT 'SPOT' AS Near, c.tenor AS Far, c.tenor_days AS Days,
  c.bid_points AS "Bid swap", c.ask_points AS "Ask swap",
  round((c.bid_points + c.ask_points) / 2 * @pip / c.spot_ref * 360 / c.tenor_days * 100, 3) AS "Implied swap rate %",
  round(s.bid_price + c.bid_points * @pip, @dp) AS "Far outright bid",
  round(s.ask_price + c.ask_points * @pip, @dp) AS "Far outright ask"
FROM curve c CROSS JOIN spot s
WHERE c.tenor_days > 0
ORDER BY c.tenor_days
